card: Refactors unit test transaction setup in miner_tests to build transactions declaratively via a MakeTx helper instead of mutating preceding transactions in place. This eliminates hidden dependencies between consecutive test cases, such as inherited script padding affecting fee rate checks, without changing transaction contents or test behavior. The change is internal test cleanup contributing to meta-issue #36692.
evidence: Part of tracking issue #36692 for declarative test data construction.

Author notes one explicit dependency uncovered: 'BulkTransaction() pads the output script of hashFreeTx2, and the next two transactions inherited it. Their size matters for the fee rate checks, so the padded script is now passed to MakeTx() explicitly.'
problem: Transactions in miner_tests were constructed by mutating previously created transactions in place, creating hidden state dependencies such as inherited script padding and making test setups difficult to read and modify independently.

risk.why: Touches only test code in miner_tests without altering production logic.

scope_notes: Touches only unit tests in miner_tests.
summary: Refactors unit test transactions in miner_tests to be constructed declaratively using a new MakeTx helper instead of modifying fields of preceding transactions. Targets TestPackageSelection, TestPrioritisedMining, CreateBigSigOpsTx, and CreateBigSigOpsCluster while preserving transaction IDs, witness IDs, and fees.
